Visit note | 2026-02-09 04:30 PM | Dr. Moinul Haque, Neurology | Patient: Sumaiya Akand, 80, female. Mrs. Akand comes in reporting a brief spinning sensation when turning in bed and dizziness when looking up. She mentions her symptoms began after bumping her head on a rickshaw hood in Khulna.
